name: project-riftfront
description: Project Riftfront - browser-based multiplayer third-person shooter vertical slice

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @riftfront/shared build && pnpm --filter @riftfront/server build && pnpm --filter @riftfront/client build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @riftfront/server build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:all: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @riftfront/server build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @riftfront/shared --filter @riftfront/server --filter @riftfront/client --filter @riftfront/tests exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:all && pnpm build && pnpm verify:browser
